cautions: Gate/transition/core coefficients may vary with board, temperature and phase current

caveats: Pressure equivalence alone does NOT reproduce LEO microgravity, atomic oxygen, UV, orbital velocity, plasma or radiative heat transfer.

afterglow.density_interpretation: number density of ionized pairs, not uncompensated net charge

plasma.caveat: Uncalibrated quasineutral ion-pair kinetics and prescribed radial trajectory. No validated plasma ignition, species chemistry, sheath fields, direct electrical plasma harvesting, shock CFD, 4-kV hardware, magnetic-field capture, or near-boundary receiver coupling. Magnetic field fraction is an energy-budget upper-bound placeholder, not evidence of measurable leakage or useful induced EMF.

secondary.engineering_note: Storage plateau is equilibrium between finite received power, load, leakage and clamp. The primary pulse generator and original resonator are externally powered. This is a hypothetical receiver feasibility model; magnetic coupling, rectifier efficiency, pulse formation, plasma kinetics, and reservoir charging must be measured. No claimed self-sustaining, net-positive, or validated high-voltage hardware.

battery_path.warning: Estimated charge-controller efficiency, threshold, quiescent draw and cell energy; no manufacturer switching / cell OCV / protection model. Positive battery SOC is stored recovered energy, not net system energy creation.

battery.warning: Estimated charge-controller efficiency, threshold, quiescent draw and cell energy; no manufacturer switching / cell OCV / protection model. Positive battery SOC is stored recovered energy, not net system energy creation.

combined.source_of_pulse_energy: Buck DC output: pulse reservoir reduces main DC load before any acoustic/pickup recovery credit

model_limits: The switched-state buck is not a manufacturer transistor/SPICE/PCB-validated power model
The 3D circuit is an interactive functional schematic, not a manufacturable wiring diagram
Buck PWM is averaged at the current operating point, while battery/buffer states are time-stepped; not real hardware telemetry
The acoustic sizing frequency is hypothetical: PWM oscillation does not prove a pressure wave exists
Plasma ignition, plasma-to-acoustic fraction, coupling, pickup conversion, and storage efficiency are uncalibrated
External vacuum does not change sealed-liquid pressure or reproduce LEO radiation/microgravity
Neither the electrical DC transfer nor bubble recovery is experimentally verified
